integrity: Finite checks reproduced with exact integer/rational arithmetic and exhaustive small-tree enumeration; infinite claim proved by generating functions.
scientific_limitations: The tree law is uniform on ordered (plane) Catalan shapes, not nonplane labeled or Yule trees.
The calculation gives covariance and sign, not a complete joint distribution.
Historical implicit coverage in uninspected literature remains possible.
title: Exact negative cherry–Sackin covariance in uniform plane full binary trees
